versions.changelog: Initial release. Drafts a court-admissible chain-of-custody record, acquisition worksheet, and examiner-action log for digital evidence aligned to NIST SP 800-86 and ISO/IEC 27037, with hash-verification gates at acquisition / duplication / transfer / return, write-blocker and tool-version capture, working-copy register, and an evidence-integrity self-check for examiner and counsel review.
